method: Every one of the ten original PNGs opened separately with view_image(detail=original); no contact-sheet-only review.

Empty choices remain explicit; both field columns, explanatory text and footer actions are visible.
Both field columns and all footer actions are visible; long execution labels are abbreviated within combo boxes and repeated in full in the source pane.

The complete 1024x728 window is visible. Both columns fit horizontally; all three footer actions and their labels are fully visible. Long content has a visible vertical scrollbar, and the red explanation wraps within its area.
Catalogue-revision mismatch and required explicit reselection are readable; footer actions remain visible.
Read-only explanation is visible, apply and clear actions are disabled, and Close remains visible.
At 760x530, the content has a visible vertical scrollbar and all three footer actions remain fully visible.
The scrolled narrow-window source pane is readable with its own scrollbar; fixed footer actions remain visible.

fixed_findings.resolution: Right-side controls and footer are now fully visible. Managed and native client dimensions agree at 1008x689; the 1024x728 outer window fits the reported 1024x728 working screen. Content extending vertically is reachable through the visible scrollbar.

acceptance_boundary: Native WinForms bitmap review of these ten captured scenarios only. No AutoCAD host, native DWG transactions, Undo, save/reopen or engineering approval.
